dialogues.jp: （屋上で鍋でもご馳走になるか……）
dialogues.en: (Maybe I'll join the others for hot pot on the roof...)
dialogues.text: (Maybe I'll join the others for hot pot on the roof...)

dialogues.jp:
天気のいい日は、外で食べるのも悪くないしな。
まだ、ちょっと寒いけど。
dialogues.en:
It's not bad to eat it outdoors when it's sunny. It might be
a little chilly though.
dialogues.text:
It's not bad to eat it outdoors when it's sunny. It might be
a little chilly though.

dialogues.en: Click...
dialogues.text: Click...

dialogues.jp: カチャ――
dialogues.en: (Huh?)
dialogues.text: (Huh?)

dialogues.jp:
ドアを｛わず／僅｝かに開けたところで、青春をほうふつ
とさせる言葉が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
I heard a male student asking someone out when I opened the
door a little.
dialogues.text:
I heard a male student asking someone out when I opened the
door a little.

dialogues.jp: （これは……）
dialogues.en: (Is this what I think it is......?)
dialogues.text: (Is this what I think it is......?)

dialogues.jp:
隙間から覗くと、やはり一組の男女が向き合っ
ていた。卒業が近くなると、学園内のどこかで
行われる儀式だ。
dialogues.en:
I could see two people facing each other. This's a familiar
sight as the graduation gets closer.
dialogues.text:
I could see two people facing each other. This's a familiar
sight as the graduation gets closer.

dialogues.jp:
顔を赤くしながら、真剣な瞳で自分の好きな女
の子を見つめる男。
dialogues.en:
The male student was blushing but staring at the female
student seriously.
dialogues.text:
The male student was blushing but staring at the female
student seriously.

dialogues.jp:
女の子の方も顔を真っ赤にして、しかしこちら
は視線を泳がせている。ただ困っているという
雰囲気はなさそうだ……。
dialogues.en:
She was blushing too but looking around. She didn't seem to
be bothered......
dialogues.text:
She was blushing too but looking around. She didn't seem to
be bothered......

dialogues.speaker: Male student
dialogues.jp: 「僕と付き合って欲しい」
dialogues.en: "Will you go out with me?"
dialogues.text: "Will you go out with me?"

dialogues.jp:
男がはっきりと、自分の願いを伝える。その男
らしい姿に、知らないやつながら好感をもって
しまう。
dialogues.en:
He was being forward. I took an instant liking to the brave
male student although I didn't even know him.
dialogues.text:
He was being forward. I took an instant liking to the brave
male student although I didn't even know him.

dialogues.jp: （こいつは、なかなかしっかりとしたやつだな）
dialogues.en: (He must be a good guy.)
dialogues.text: (He must be a good guy.)

dialogues.jp:
それに、なによりその真剣な目が、相手への想
いの強さを証明している。
dialogues.en: His sincere look proves his feeling for the girl's serious.
dialogues.text: His sincere look proves his feeling for the girl's serious.

dialogues.jp:
つい、ドラマを見ている気分で、男に声援を送
りたくなってしまう。
dialogues.en: It was like a TV show, and I wanted to cheer for him.
dialogues.text: It was like a TV show, and I wanted to cheer for him.

dialogues.speaker: Male student
dialogues.jp: 「どうかな？」
dialogues.en: "What do you say?"
dialogues.text: "What do you say?"

dialogues.jp:
緊張の影に隠れていた男の優しげな瞳が、女の
子を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
He stared at the girl with a gentle look behind his
nervousness.
dialogues.text:
He stared at the girl with a gentle look behind his
nervousness.

dialogues.jp: 手に冷や汗がまとわりつく。
dialogues.en: My hands were sweating.
dialogues.text: My hands were sweating.

dialogues.jp:
女の子が、所在なげに泳がせていた瞳を、告白
している男に向ける。
dialogues.en:
She stopped moving her eyes around and fixed them onto the
guy.
dialogues.text:
She stopped moving her eyes around and fixed them onto the
guy.

dialogues.jp:
その瞳は、熱におかされているかのように、潤
んでいた。
dialogues.en: Her eyes were welling up with tears.
dialogues.text: Her eyes were welling up with tears.

dialogues.jp:
か細い声――でも、しっかりと意思のこもった
返事が、俺の耳にもとどいた。
dialogues.en: I heard her reply -- in a small but sincere voice.
dialogues.text: I heard her reply -- in a small but sincere voice.

dialogues.en: (He did it!!)
dialogues.text: (He did it!!)

dialogues.jp:
俺は心の中で叫ぶと、さっきまでとは違った緊
張感に包まれたふたりに祝福の眼差しを向け、
そっと扉を閉めた……。
dialogues.en:
I screamed inside for them, and closed the door to leave
them be......
dialogues.text:
I screamed inside for them, and closed the door to leave
them be......

dialogues.jp: ――お幸せに。
dialogues.en: ...I wished them happiness.
dialogues.text: ...I wished them happiness.

dialogues.jp: ◆告白の場面◆
dialogues.en: ◆Asking out◆
dialogues.text: ◆Asking out◆

dialogues.jp:
鍋でもごちそうになろうと屋上へ行くと、まさ
に、男子学生が女子に告白している場面だった。
dialogues.en:
I was going to join the others for hot pot on the roof deck,
but encountered a male student asking out a female student.
dialogues.text:
I was going to join the others for hot pot on the roof deck,
but encountered a male student asking out a female student.

dialogues.jp: 思わず、｛かたず／固唾｝を呑む俺。
dialogues.en: I watched them tensely.
dialogues.text: I watched them tensely.

dialogues.jp: と、女子学生から、“はい”という返事。
dialogues.en: The female student accepted the male student's request.
dialogues.text: The female student accepted the male student's request.

dialogues.jp: お幸せに。
dialogues.en: I wished them happiness.
dialogues.text: I wished them happiness.
